ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity (white) pixels cover approximately 80% of the interior surface area, contrasted by a low-intensity (black) border region along the trailing and lateral edges.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central region consists of a continuous high-intensity white mask. Low-intensity black pigment is localized as a thick, irregular band along the trailing edge and lateral tips, with isolated vertical streaks and small spots in the lower-left and central regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Calculated acute V-shaped notch with an internal angle of approximately 45 degrees; the apex is sharply defined at the intersection of the lobe boundaries.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude irregular serration across the entire trailing edge, with individual peak variations of 2-8 pixels resulting from biological encrustation and natural lobe morphology.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Double convex curve trajectory; lobes sweep upward and outward from the median notch toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed clusters of high-intensity circular nodes (barnacle colonies) located on the distal ends of both left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several low-intensity vertical linear streaks (rake-like marks) visible in the lower quadrant of the left lobe pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive macro-level barnacle colonization (sessile cirripedes) along the distal margins; possible minor tissue irregularity on the far right tip.
other_distinctive_markers: A distinct, small low-intensity circular ring mark is located in the middle region of the right lobe surface.
